HKUST’s pioneering spirit is amplified through the “Unified HKUST, Complementary Campuses” framework, expanded by the opening of the innovative HKUST(Guangzhou) campus in 2022, which deepens its interdisciplinary reach into the Greater Bay Area and beyond.

The HKUST School of Medicine
HKUST is embarking on a landmark initiative to establish the third medical school of Hong Kong following the successful proposal of the University and subsequent official approval from the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region Government.
The HKUST School of Medicine aspires to be a transformative force, focused on world-class education and research while attracting global talents. The University was founded on the principle that education, original scholarship, and the development of society are integrally linked and best pursued together. It has the objective of becoming a world leading University with significant international impact and strong local commitment. In relentless pursuit of excellence, it leads the advance of and education in science, technology, business, humanities and social science.
Celebrating its 30 th birthday during the most challenging time in the recent decade with mounting global issues of the coronavirus, economic downturn and climate change, the University sees a growing demand for pressing solutions to respond to these emerging challenges. To address these and other global issues, it is essential to bring to the University a diversity of talents and open up new horizons in high-impact areas. One of the objectives in HKUST Strategic Plan 2021-2028 ( https://strategicplan.hkust.edu.hk/ ) is to be “A University of TALENTS”, extending our global reservoir of minds and abilities by looking beyond conventional academic disciplines and being open to the recruitment and nurturing of more diverse areas of strength among students, faculty and staff. Concurring with this objective, the University will conduct a strategic hiring campaign aimed at advancing the University’s academic strengths in selected cross-disciplinary areas that are strategically important to HKUST’s future development. We are seeking renowned scholars, academics, leaders or potential leaders in the core cross-disciplinary areas of (A) Biomedical Science and Translational Medicine ; (B) Material Science and Future Energy ; (C) AI, Future Computing and Electronics ; (D) Innovation for Business Management and FinTech ; (E) Environmental Science, Sustainability and Green Tech ; and (F) Art Tech and Humanities .
Applications are invited for a number of senior substantiation-track faculty positions at the rank of Professor or Associate Professor in the above areas. Joint appointments in more than one academic department in the University are encouraged . Successful candidates should have a PhD degree in related fields and preferably have demonstrated a solid research track record in the above areas. Apart from having an exceptional research record, successful candidates should demonstrate strong potential as excellent teachers and advisors. Good ability in communicating research problems well beyond one’s own research area, especially with organizations and industry partners, is considered a plus.
Appointments can start as early as on 1 June 2023. Salary is highly competitive and will be commensurate with qualifications and experience. Fringe benefits include medical/dental benefits, annual leave, and housing benefits where applicable.
Details of the six core cross-disciplinary areas (A) to (F) are as follows:
(A) Biomedical Science and Translational Medicine
Building on the current strength in biological sciences and translational medicine, the University aims to further enhance the research and educational capacity in this important area to address the pressing health issues locally and worldwide. We are seeking motivated scientists who share the same vision and aim to transform medicine using advanced multi-omics diagnosis, AI-driven preventive medicine data analytics, advanced imaging and data integration, precision medicine by gene editing or advanced therapies, or other advanced approaches that provide important insights into disease mechanisms. The candidate will provide leadership in research and teaching in the general area of biomedical sciences with a clear path to translate pre-clinical research into clinical trials and experimental medicine efforts. The candidate will also be expected to develop new research links with internal units and external partners at the interface between medicine and industry.
(B) Material Science and Future Energy
HKUST is the world leader in material and energy research. We are seeking talents in the areas including but not limited to advanced electronic materials, photonic materials, low-dimensional and quantum materials, modern functional magnetic materials, polymers, ultra-microscopy and materials characterization, energy materials, clean energy storage solutions, waste to energy, advanced batteries, advanced solar cells, building energy, ocean energy, smart grid, artificial intelligence in power sector, and electric vehicles.
(C) AI, Future Computing and Electronics
Building on the existing strength in AI, Future Computing and Electronics, we aim to attract outstanding senior scholars to conduct cutting-edge research within the state-of-the-art facilities and demonstrate leadership in research and education excellence endeavors.
Areas of interest include but not limited to data science, artificial intelligence, machine learning, future computing, emergent electronics and optoelectronics, computer architecture, integrated circuits, quantum engineering and computing, wireless communications and networking, cybersecurity, human-computer interactions, robotics, IoT, etc.
(D) Innovation for Business Management and FinTech
We seek talents in cutting-edge research in fintech, sustainability and green finance, business analytics and experimentation, family business, as well as basic business and economics disciplines. A PhD degree in business, economics, computer science or related areas is expected.
Areas of interest include but not limited to Blockchain, Robo-advising, Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning in Finance and Business; Business Analytics and Experimental Research; Technological Innovations in Business; the Interplay between Technology, Regulation, and Business; Digital Economy and Financial Inclusion; Family Business and Wealth Management; Sustainability and Green Finance, etc.
(E) Environmental Science, Sustainability and Green Tech
Building on the existing strength in environmental science and engineering, and sustainability, the University aims to enhance and expand the research and educational capacity to address the pressing environmental issues locally and globally. We are seeking motivated candidates who will provide leadership in research and education in the following broad areas of interest, including but not limited to Air Quality Management; Carbon Reduction Technology, Energy Saving and Green Buildings; Smart City; Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG); Climate Risk Assessment, Modelling and Extreme Weather Prediction; Green Architecture, Green Finance; Life Cycle Assessment; Green Transport; Waste Reduction; Net-zero Electricity Generation, etc.
(F) Art Tech and Humanities
The Art Tech focus area looks for candidates working on art creation and visual communication with cutting-edge technologies. Candidates working on broad topics on Generative AI for Art or specifically on topics like AR/VR Art with Metaverse, Robotics Art, Data Art, Computer Graphics and 3D animation, AI-generated performance/visual arts, and other forms of computational arts are welcome to apply.
In the Humanities, we encourage applications from senior scholars in areas including but not limited to Digital Humanities, Chinese and Comparative Philosophy, Ancient Chinese History, and Cantonese Linguistics. Researchers focusing on health and society, governance, and computational and experimental approaches to social science topics are also encouraged to apply.

Please submit the application via the HKUST/HKUST(GZ) Recruitment System ( https://facrecruit.hkust.edu.hk/ ). You should first sign up to create your personal account. At the section of “Application Information”, please select your choice(s) of areas from the “Strategic Hiring” under the “HKUST Hong Kong Campus”.

The Division of Integrative Systems and Design (ISD) strives to study and promote leadership in the design and creation of innovative products and systems. We support cross-disciplinary research projects. The specific research areas of interest include design theory, digital technology and society, smart society, robotics and AI, IoT for integrative system, modelling, simulation and verification technology for integrative systems design as well as design for cross disciplinary research.
Applicants should have a PhD degree in engineering, design or a closely related field. Successful candidates are expected to develop strong, independent and innovative programs of externally sponsored research; contribute to both undergraduate and graduate teaching across the Division, as well as participate in services of the Division, the Academy of Interdisciplinary Studies and the University.
About ISD in HKUST
The Division aspires to nurture a new generation of innovators who can work across multiple disciplines and create disruptive innovations. The vision of ISD is to 1) provide state-of-the-art project-based experiential learning in design education and 2) be a cradle for nurturing innovators and researchers with a design and system thinking mindset as well as an entrepreneurial spirit. The Division provides comprehensive teaching and research programs in integrated design and systems thinking. The academic degrees offered by ISD are a BSc in Innovation, Design and Technology, a MSc in Technology Leadership & Entrepreneurship, a MPhil degree in Technology Innovation and Entrepreneurship and a PhD and MPhil programs in Integrative Systems and Design. We are expanding rapidly and looking to broaden into disciplines such as sports, marine technology and medical technology.
The Division provides an excellent home for faculty and students that are multi-disciplinary and inclined strongly to an experiential learning mindset. We encourage any potential candidates to visit the ISD webpage at https://isd.hkust.edu.hk to get a better sense of the diverse range of interests and projects of our current faculty.

The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (HKUST) established the Division of Arts ad Machine Creativity (AMC) in July 2024 under the Academy of Interdisciplinary Studies (AIS), the fifth school of HKUST. As an interdisciplinary academic unit, AMC aims to be a leading center where technology, art, and humanities converge to drive creativity and innovation. We are seeking a high-caliber academic administrator to lead this new Division as the Founding Head.
The Role
Reporting to the Dean of AIS, the Founding Head will provide leadership and manage the Division's academic and administrative functions. Key responsibilities include advancing interdisciplinary teaching and research, faculty recruitment, and resource management. The Head will also develop strategies to promote the Division and facilitate interdisciplinary collaboration within HKUST and externally with arts organizations, as well as private, governmental, and non-governmental entities.
The Candidate
Applicants should be distinguished scholars or artists with outstanding academic and/or professional accomplishments, consistent with an appointment as Full Professor with tenure or equivalent. While a background in the arts is preferred, expertise in art technology and other related areas will be considered. Prior administrative experience is highly desirable. Candidates should demonstrate proven leadership, managerial capabilities, experience in leading collaborative programs, and success in securing external funding. The ability to engage effectively with arts organizations, government, industry, and commercial sectors is advantageous.
The Division
The Division of Arts and Machine Creativity (AMC) is an interdisciplinary academic unit envisioned as a pioneering center where technology, art, and humanities drive creativity and innovation. This initiative fosters a fusion of innovation and humanities, supporting HKUST’s Strategic Plan 2031 as a major effort to expand academic frontiers through, aiming to lead positive changes in education and research, and empower the next generation to address global challenges.
The mission of the Division includes:
Bridging the gap between technology and art, by providing students and researchers with professional education and robust environment.
Cultivating artistic and creative talents equipped with the skills and knowledge to leverage emerging technologies such as AI and machine learning.
Fostering a cross-disciplinary environment that empowers collaboration and innovation among artists and technologists.
Developing cutting-edge, interdisciplinary research and education programs in partnership with other institutions in the fields of arts and machine learning
AMC’s focus areas include: (a) digital art practice (including visual, sound, performing, installation, cinematic arts); (b) machine creativity; (c) art management covering managerial, legal, and business topics related to AI arts, NFT, etc.; and (d) critical studies examining art history, media theory, and philosophy of technology in the context of arts and machine creativity. The Division will offer graduate degree programs, including MA and MFA programs, as well as MPhil/PhD programs. It will also provide common core courses for all undergraduates at HKUST, and potentially undergraduate programs in future. The Division will collaborate with the Computational Media and Arts Thrust of HKUST(GZ) to advance scientific research in artificial intelligence in generative creativity and machine creativity.
The University
Founded in 1991, HKUST is a world-renowned international research university dedicated to the advancement of learning, research, scholarship, and the education of a new generation of elite students through top-tier programs in science, engineering, business & management, humanities & social science, and interdisciplinary studies.
HKUST is deeply committed to advancing humanities and arts education and research. The School of Humanities and Social Science offers diverse music and creative writing courses led by distinguished artists and active practitioners. Courses include “Music of the World”, “Introduction to Music Composition”, and “Chinese Creative Writing”, fostering creativity and collaboration. Additionally, film courses like “Independent Cinema in Contemporary China” are offered, broadening students' artistic perspectives.
Since it was founded 33 years ago, HKUST has already established a strong presence in global higher education and received a number of international recognitions. Among others, HKUST was ranked No.3 in the Times Higher Education’s Young University Rankings 2024, 12 of its subjects were ranked among the world’s top 50 in the QS World University Rankings by Subject 2024. While the University is deeply rooted in Hong Kong, HKUST (GZ) in Guangzhou, Mainland China complements the well-established disciplinary foundation at the Hong Kong campus with 4 transdisciplinary hubs and 16 thrust areas. We are dedicated to educating well-rounded students with strong entrepreneurial spirits and innovative and globally oriented thinking. English is the medium of teaching, research, and administration at HKUST. HKUST promotes diversity with an inclusive and collaborative community and the use of modern instructional methods.
Terms & Applications
The appointment will be concurrent with a substantive professorial appointment. The headship will be a full-time appointment for an initial term of three years, and renewable for another term, subject to further review. HKUST provides competitive remuneration and generous fringe benefits, including housing where appropriate.
Application, including a curriculum vitae, a vision statement, as well as names and email addresses of at least three referees, should be sent to the AMC Head Search Committee (c/o Academy of Interdisciplinary Studies), the Hong Kong University of Science and Technology, Clearwater Bay, Kowloon, Hong Kong (or by email: amcdhsearch@ust.hk ). Review of applications will begin from early December 2024 and continue until the position is filled.
For more information about the University, the Academy of Interdisciplinary Studies and the AMC Division, please visit https://hkust.edu.hk/ and https://ais.hkust.edu.hk/ respectively.
